title: How to use Claude to make mods to let it control grand strategy games
author: Kaltovar
selftext:
I recently made such a mod for Hearts of Iron 4, letting Claude control the AI countries to make them smarter and more engaging to deal with.

What you want to do is pick your chosen game, give Claude access to the game's folder and your mods folder, and any modding documentation you can find, and instruct it to make a mod that will let it influence the AI countries of the game. It's best to start by asking it how much influence it could exert over the NPC countries if it made such a mod, and then expanding the scope from there. Claude doesn't always realize all the things it can do, so it helps if you're familiar with the code/modding of the specific game you're working with.

If you want to look at the code to see how I did it, the mod along with install instructions that should be roughly applicable for your own attempts to duplicate this type of mod can be found by downloading the mod from the Steam Workshop.
